question.name: apple_evidence
question.instructions: Does this text provide explicit or clear descriptive evidence of an apple fruit? Count apple fruit names, apple cultivars and recognizable descriptions of the fruit as yes. A dog, another fruit, unspecified fruit, or Apple computers and the company without an apple fruit reference count as no.

cases.input: I ate an apple after lunch.
She sliced a green apple into wedges.
We baked apples with cinnamon for dessert.
The Granny Smith fruit I picked in the orchard tasted tart.
I bit into a juicy Honeycrisp fruit.
My dog barked at the mail carrier.
I sliced a ripe pear for breakfast.
I ate some fruit, but I will not say which kind.
I picked a round, crisp fruit from the tree. It had red skin, white flesh, and a small core with seeds.
Apple released a new laptop with a faster processor.
